doc.title: Young Snooky — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Rejoining Basie from 1945 and the dates to the Tonight Show
summary: Brown and Young sort out whether he was with Basie 1945-48 and that he stayed until joining the Tonight Show in 1962.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: I don‘t know, I haven‘t seen it myself, I don‘t know. [laughs] But now I‘m looking again, so it says you went back to Basie in June of ‘45. Is that correct, you went back and you were with him from June ‘45 to January 1948, is that correct?
Say that again?
That you performed with Count Basie‘s band from June of 1945 to January 1948? Were you with Basie‘s Band at this period?
Yes. What did I do after that? You said from ‗45-‗48?
Yes, you were with Basie‘s band, is that correct?
Yes. That‘s right. But is that when I went into the Tonight Show?
No, we‘re talking about Count Basie‘s band.
We‘re talking about Count Basie‘s band?
Yeah. From 1945-‗48, so it would‘ve been right after the war.
Trying to figure out what I did ‗48, ‗49. I don‘t see, I can‘t. You got a…I was in Count Basie‘s band from ‗45-‗49?
According to this to ‘48, from 1945-1948.
But this might not be correct.
It might not be correct, Is that what you say?
Yeah, it may not be correct.
Yeah well I see, it‘s hard for me to bring that together, to put that together.

Okay. So let‘s just go, and you‘re in California from 1942…uh…no let‘s say late ‘42 and then you‘re working with various bands, we‘ve already mentioned Les Hite, Lionel Hampton‘s band, Benny Carter‘s band, and then according to this biography, then you rejoined Count Basie.
Yes, that‘s right, and I stayed in Count Basie‘s band until I went on the Tonight
Oh, ok.

When I recorded then I stayed with Count Basie…till…till…I stayed with Count Basie till I went on the Tonight Show. I never played with anybody else other than Basie, and I stayed with Basie and then I went on the Tonight Show. What year did I go on the Tonight Show?
Well here it says in 1962…
‘62 that‘s right.
